### Recorded coverage gaps (not scored)

- `juice-basket-idor` — routes/basket.ts:19 (CWE-639): Basket lookup uses a request path id without an ownership predicate. VibeGuard does not claim generic IDOR detection; recorded as a coverage gap, not scored as a false negative.

## Reproduce

```bash
node benchmarks/external/run.js --refresh --update-baseline
node benchmarks/external/run.js --offline --verify
node benchmarks/external/run.js --gate
```

## Limitations

- The label set is curated, not a representative sample of all vulnerabilities.
- Whole-repository findings are ignored to avoid scoring deliberate Juice Shop noise outside the labels.
- The target commit is pinned; changing the commit requires re-labeling.
- Metrics are reproducible only with the same scanner source hash and target hashes.
- This benchmark measures detection output, not exploitation or runtime enforcement.
